Certified rent roll controls occupancy and scheduled rents; manager headline includes pending as leased but we exclude pending from physical occupancy metrics.

Underwriting follows prescribed assumptions: roll-based GPR, 5% economic loss, $350/unit other income, T12 taxes/insurance/other opex, 3% management fee, $300/unit reserves, cap NOI before reserves at 7.50%, and debt sizing at the greater of note rate (6.75%) vs floor (6.00%).
Historical T12 is cash basis and not a roll-annualized total; reported NOI is definitionally different from underwritten NOI and NCF.
arguments.summary: Files created: underwriting model (artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx) with live formulas and sensitivity; offering memorandum (artifacts/memorandum-v2.pdf). Key takeaways: 12-suite, 66,360 SF office; 9 active, 1 pending, 2 vacant. In-place annualized rent from active suites is $1,214,100; stabilized GPR $1,618,800. Underwritten EGI $1,542,060; UW NOI before reserves $1,042,534; UW NCF $1,038,934. Capitalization value at 7.50% is $13.90MM. Loan sizing at 6.75% amortizing 30 years yields LTV-constrained maximum loan $8.34MM; net cash out approximately $1.712MM after fees and $6.5MM payoff. Risks: manager’s pending-in-occupancy treatment (present) and one near-term lease expiry within 12 months (present). No missing insurance, no capital misclassification in opex, no unsigned rent changes, no temporary free rent, floor not binding, and no refinance shortfall.
